caption: The drawing depicts a central, darkly shaded, metallic stand with three curved legs and a circular top platform, from which a hexagonal handle extends vertically. Attached to the platform are outlines of two matching glass bottles, each with a rounded, faceted body and a tall neck, topped with an ornate, pointed stopper. To the left and right of the stand, there are additional outline drawings of individual bottles: one topped with a smaller, round stopper and another with a more conical, pointed stopper, all sharing similar faceted bodies. Below the main objects, there is a geometric top-down view in outline, showing the arrangement of four circular holders around a central rectangular section, corresponding to the positions where bottles would sit. The color of the drawing is primarily grayscale pencil on a beige or light tan paper. The name "Eugene J. Passerell" appears written in small script in the bottom right corner.
title: Pewter Caster
